name: agentsh
description: Installs agentsh execution-layer security with bash and sh shell shims, a default policy, a non-overridable security floor, and policy-based approvals served over the agentsh REST API.

version.description: Pinned agentsh stable release to install, without the leading v.

approvalTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds an approval-required action waits before failing secure (deny).

shimForceNonTty.description: Force shell shim mediation for non-interactive agent subprocesses.

installShellShims.description: Replace /bin/sh and /bin/bash with agentsh shell shims so every shell invocation is mediated. Leave true for the secure production default. Set false only for validation/advanced scenarios (for example the Dev Container test harness, which bootstraps containers through /bin/sh); agentsh, policies, config, and the shim binary are still installed when false.

installDevDependencies.description: Install curl, certificates, jq, Python, PyYAML, and shell dependencies when missing.

policyOverlayPath.description: Workspace-relative policy overlay path that replaces the default user policy while preserving the security floor.

externalRestApi.description: Bind the agentsh REST API on all container interfaces for a sidecar notifier. Requires restApiKey.

restPort.description: Port for the agentsh REST API.

restApiKey.description: API key required by external notifier sidecars. Required when externalRestApi is true.
